# ThreadSanitizer suppressions for the thread-sanitizer CI job
# (.github/scripts/check-tsan.sh). Keep each entry to one named cause.

# SwiftNIO's bridge from an EventLoopFuture to async/await
# (EventLoopFuture.get(), NIOCore/AsyncAwaitSupport.swift) resumes an
# UnsafeContinuation on the event loop's thread. The report pairs that
# resume's read of a task's frame with a later write of a continuation into
# the same slot, which a task makes only once it runs again. The resume
# orders the two inside the Swift runtime, and the sanitizer does not
# reliably carry that order. Seen on main at 52efea40 and 51f435af; the
# write's stack names no caller, and the event loop's thread was started by
# NodeRuntime.start, whose Ivy start awaits such a future (inferred).
race:EventLoopFuture.get
